description: PingPrompt helps users create, search, organize, and safely edit reusable prompt artifacts from ChatGPT. The app connects ChatGPT to the user's PingPrompt workspace so prompts can be saved into projects, opened in the PingPrompt editor, versioned from the first save, and updated through validated patches that refuse missing or ambiguous edits.
